graph.name: christmas-bell-esp32
graph.description: Automatic Christmas bell, variant ESP32 (D-13): like the SMD variant, with a LILYGO T-Display V1.1 (ESP32, 1.14 inch TFT) instead of the Nano. 3.3 V logic: the buttons switch 3V3, the LEDs run from 3.3 V outputs (yellow-green instead of emerald green, D-14).

conventions.pin_reference: '<designator>.<pin>' with the pin numbers of the EasyEDA symbol
conventions.v: per net: [min, max] in V over all operating states
conventions.waive: per net or component: {check id: reason} accepts a finding on purpose

hints.H-1: C1 1000 µF / 16 V electrolytic on +5V, next to J1 (it buffers the module's 5V pin)
hints.H-3: to be debounced in the ESP32 firmware like buttons.ino (50 ms); the firmware port is open (D-13)
hints.H-7: J1 is the servo's own cable inside the bell's frame, plugged once; no TVS – like the main board

components.label: LILYGO T-Display V1.1 (plugged in)
components.notes: Plugs into two 1x12 female headers, pitch 2.54 mm, rows 22.86 mm apart (hand-soldered, not in the graph). Powered through its USB-C socket; its 5V pin (VBUS behind the module's 1N5819) supplies the servo and C1, its 3V3 pin (AP2112K) the buttons. Strapping pins IO12/IO15/IO2 and the second 3V3 pin stay free. LCSC C18722937 is a stand-in for the EasyEDA device: its symbol and footprint are rebuilt in the project (D-13).

components.label: Servo (GND, +5 V, signal), SMD header
components.notes: Standard servo plug: brown = GND (1), red = +5 V (2), orange = signal (3). SMD header, placed by JLCPCB (D-11).

components.label: Buffer capacitor for the servo (SMD)
components.notes: Absorbs the servo's start-up peaks so the ESP32 does not reset. SMD can (D-11).

components.label: 0805 LED, yellow-green, countdown step 1
components.notes: D-14: yellow-green (VF 1.8-2.4 V) instead of emerald green (2.6-3.1 V) – the ESP32's 3.3 V outputs do not drive the emerald green reliably

components.label: 0805 LED, yellow-green, countdown step 2
components.notes: D-14: yellow-green (VF 1.8-2.4 V) instead of emerald green (2.6-3.1 V) – the ESP32's 3.3 V outputs do not drive the emerald green reliably

components.label: 0805 LED, yellow, countdown step 3
components.notes: D-11: KT-0805 series, pin 1 = anode, pin 2 = cathode (footprint mark at pad 2)

components.label: 0805 LED, yellow, countdown step 4
components.notes: D-11: KT-0805 series, pin 1 = anode, pin 2 = cathode (footprint mark at pad 2)

components.label: 0805 LED, red, countdown step 5
components.notes: D-11: KT-0805 series, pin 1 = anode, pin 2 = cathode (footprint mark at pad 2)

components.label: Start button
components.notes: 1/2 and 3/4 are connected inside the button.

components.label: Reset button
components.notes: 1/2 and 3/4 are connected inside the button.

components.label: Base load for USB power banks (R8 ∥ R9 = 50 Ω, 100 mA)
components.notes: Keeps a power bank from switching off (D-8): without the base load the board draws about 90–150 mA (simulated; the module's own current is an assumption), with it at least 176 mA.

components.label: Base load for USB power banks (R8 ∥ R9 = 50 Ω, 100 mA)
components.notes: Keeps a power bank from switching off (D-8): without the base load the board draws about 90–150 mA (simulated; the module's own current is an assumption), with it at least 176 mA.

nets.name: +5V
nets.notes: 5V pin of the T-Display: USB VBUS behind the module's 1N5819; supplies the servo and C1.

nets.name: +3V3
nets.notes: 3V3 pin of the T-Display (AP2112K-3.3); switched to the inputs by the buttons (D-13).

nets.name: SERVO
nets.notes: IO13, 3.3 V PWM into the servo's signal input (D-13).

nets.name: BTN_START
nets.notes: Pressed = 3.3 V at IO38 (input only), else R7 pulls to GND (D-13).

nets.name: BTN_RESET
nets.notes: Pressed = 3.3 V at IO37 (input only), else R6 pulls to GND (D-13).
